name: io.github.pablo-albaladejo/kaiord
description: Convert, validate, and inspect workout files (FIT, TCX, ZWO, Garmin Connect) for AI agents.

tools.name: kaiord_get_format_spec
tools.description: Get the KRD format specification. Call this before creating or editing KRD documents.

tools.name: kaiord_list_formats
tools.description: List all supported fitness data formats with capabilities

tools.name: kaiord_convert
tools.description: Convert between fitness data formats (FIT, TCX, ZWO, GCN, KRD). FIT output is returned as base64 text unless output_file is given. On the remote endpoint, ZWO input is checked for well-formedness only, not against the XSD, and only structured workouts are accepted.

input_content.description: Inline content (text or base64 for binary)

ftp.description: Athlete FTP in watts. Required for GCN output when the workout has %FTP power targets (resolved to watts)

tools.name: kaiord_validate
tools.description: Validate a KRD JSON document against the schema On the remote endpoint, ZWO input is checked for well-formedness only, not against the XSD, and only structured workouts are accepted.

tools.name: kaiord_round_trip_validate
tools.description: Validate round-trip FIT conversion (FIT → KRD → FIT) and report tolerance violations

tools.name: kaiord_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a fitness file and return a human-readable summary

input_content.description: Inline content (text or base64 for binary)

tools.name: kaiord_extract_workout
tools.description: Extract the structured workout from a fitness file as JSON

input_content.description: Inline content (text or base64 for binary)

tools.name: kaiord_diff
tools.description: Compare two fitness files and show differences

content1.description: Inline content of the first input (text or base64 for binary)

content2.description: Inline content of the second input (text or base64 for binary)

format1.description: Format of the first input (auto-detected from file1)

format2.description: Format of the second input (auto-detected from file2)
